title: A collaborator without a Frequency account can vote on dates from the email link

source.ref: Hub plan 2026-11-24 (project thread: Design a central project and messaging hub; owner ask 2026-11-24 17:35Z: AI meeting and date management so everyone can brainstorm the best date and time)

detail:
FOUND 2026-11-24: owner ruling 2026-11-24 makes email the only outside channel for now, so outside collaborators (a venue, a guest teacher) must be able to pick a date from their inbox. Fix: a signed, expiring vote link per person per Plan (signTimeVoteToken/verifyTimeVoteToken) opening a one-page vote with no sign-in; the vote records the email address against the Plan.

DONE 2026-11-24: a signed, expiring (21 days) link per person per Plan (lib/calendar/time-vote-token.ts, HMAC in its own time-vote namespace, TIME_VOTE_SECRET falling back to UNSUBSCRIBE_SECRET) opens /find-a-time/<token> with no sign-in; answers land in space_calendar_time_votes under the lower-cased email through the service role after the link verifies, scoped to that Plan's live candidate dates. Send link in the Find a time panel emails it (buildTimeVoteInviteEmail, in the sample catalog).

verify.note: Passes once lib/calendar exports signTimeVoteToken and verifyTimeVoteToken.
